description: Dubai International Airport, UAE. Elevation (62 ft) agrees across Wikipedia, SkyBrary, SkyVector and a 2015 operator pilot-information sheet. ARP uses Sprinkle.com/LFS's 25.2498/55.3710, which sits near the geometric midpoint of the four runway thresholds; Wikipedia/SkyBrary's alternative figure coincides almost exactly with the 12R threshold instead, which looks like a propagated data error (OurAirports has a resolved problem report about bad 12R/30L coordinates) rather than a second ARP measurement. Not checked against the UAE GCAA AIP. trafficAreaNm, groundMaxSpeedKt, groundAltitudeMarginFt and arrivalSpeedFloorKt carried over unchanged from other packs. See docs/OMDB_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md.
name: Dubai International
